verdict.rationale: Brex offers webhooks for event-driven automation and third-party integration examples (Zapier, Workato, Pipedream) that can implement recurring workflows like a 'Monthly Export of Brex Card Transactions to CSV', but there is no native Brex scheduling/cron API for recurring jobs — the scheduling logic lives entirely in external tools. Missing for 10: a first-party recurring-job/schedule API or documented native cron-like trigger, and any hands-on evidence that AI-native users actually configure recurring automations directly through Brex rather than third-party platforms.
